author: Arhan Canli
purpose: Every cost a funded book would pay, and for each one where the paper-live record charges it: at the venue (CHARGED_AT_SOURCE), by model on the published curve (CHARGED_BY_MODEL), or not at all (NOT_CHARGED, with the reason). The record is read as net of the charged rows and gross of the rest; nothing here is a forecast.

model.published_as: cost_charged_curve beside live_curve on every Alpaca sleeve and on the book in data/paper/state.json; the broker NAV is the original and is never replaced
model.parameters_source: configs/<profile>.yaml costs: equity_commission_bps, equity_half_spread_bps, impact_coef, equity_borrow_bps_annual (research's own values; nothing typed here)

equity_paper_live.venue: Alpaca paper trading; fills carry fee_quote 0.0 and the account equity is published verbatim

market_impact.model: filled notional x impact_coef x sigma_daily x sqrt(notional / ADV); ADV = 30-session median quote volume and sigma = EWMA (halflife 240 sessions) daily volatility from the daily-bar lakes, both as of the session before the fill; a fill above the model's 5 percent participation tripwire is charged at the tripwire and counted as floored (understated), never skipped; a fill with no priceable ADV is counted unpriced and charged commission and spread only

latency_slippage.reason: research adds a flat 2 bp intra-second arrival add-on; live equity submit-to-fill is measured in hours (artifacts/analysis/cost_model_realism/result.json), a different kind of quantity, and no reference mid is recorded at submission from which an implementation shortfall could be measured. Charging 2 bp would be typing a number. The fix is one recorded field (the mid at submitted_ts), named in that study.
latency_slippage.will_charge_when: the order audit records the reference mid at submission and a measured arrival slippage exists

short_borrow.model: reconstructed short notional x equity_borrow_bps_annual / 365 per calendar day; short notional = cumulative signed filled quantity per symbol, marked at the last lake close on or before the day, because the broker persists no daily positions

financing_margin_interest.reason: src/alphaforge/execution/financing.py exists with no production caller and no rate source is wired; the sleeves run gross at or under 1.0x so the margin debit is small but not zero
financing_margin_interest.will_charge_when: a financing quote provider is bound and declared

cash_yield_on_idle_capital.reason: no cash-rate source is wired; omitting it understates the record (a funded book earns the cash rate on idle capital), so the cost-charged curve is conservative on this row
cash_yield_on_idle_capital.will_charge_when: a financing quote provider is bound and declared

fx_conversion.reason: every sleeve is USD-only; a mixed-currency book fails closed in research

crypto_paper_live.venue: the sleeve's own paper engine walks the live order book

commission.source: src/alphaforge/execution/paper.py taker fee debited per fill

bid_ask_spread.source: fills walk the live book; marks at mid

latency_slippage.reason: recorded as an audit row per fill, not debited

accounting_rule: A correction to the record keeps the original and discloses the correction (docs/design/ALPHAC_OWNER_GOALS_2026-09-12.md). The broker NAV stays published as live_curve; the cost-charged curve is published beside it as cost_charged_curve and is the series the forward-evidence evaluation reads from the date this contract takes force. The change is declared in config/live_change_contract.json.
claim_boundary: Model-charged frictions are a conservative accounting of what a funded book would pay on these exact fills, not a measurement of what one paid. NOT_CHARGED rows make the cost-charged curve still gross of those items, and the two omissions that understate the record (financing) and overstate it (cash yield) are named rather than netted.
